name: @matatbread/matbot-hook-logger
description: Diagnostic plugin: registers a hook on every channel (screen/contribute/toolcall/toolresult/followup) and console.logs when each fires. For exercising and debugging the hook pipeline.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "process.env.MATBOT_PUBLISH_ALL || (console.error('Refused: publish with pnpm publish-all from the repo root. It checks versions, contents and the web bundle first.'), process.exit(1))"
